questions.question: She said she had never seen such a beautiful sunset before, but she was certain it would be the last time she would witness it. If she had known how dramatic the sky would become, she *wouldn’t have* left early.

Although he *had been* tired all day, he insisted on helping his colleagues with their presentations. His manager was surprised by his determination, especially since he *hadn’t* been working on them himself.
The project was *completed* by the team last week, despite initial concerns about resources. The success was largely attributed to their ability to adapt quickly to changes.
If I *had* known the meeting was going to be so long, I *would have* suggested we take a break earlier. Instead, I *ended up* staying until the end.

He *accused* his colleague of stealing the documents, but there was no evidence to support his claim. The situation was further complicated when the accused individual *claimed* they had received permission from their supervisor.

Despite *facing* criticism from some of his peers, the scientist’s research was widely praised for its innovative approach. His team *continued* working on the project, even after the initial doubts were raised.

She *mentioned* that she *hadn’t* seen him in years and wondered if he was still in town. Her friend replied that she *had* heard he was moving to another city, but she *didn’t know* when he would leave.
options: mentioned / hadn’t seen / wondered / had heard
mentioned / had seen / wondered / had heard
mentioned / hadn’t seen / wondered / didn’t hear
questions.answer: mentioned / hadn’t seen / wondered / had heard

questions.question: The old library *is known* for its historical significance, but many modern readers *find* it difficult to navigate. Some prefer the digital archives, which *provide* more convenient access to resources.
He *recommended* that they *avoid* the crowded section of the park during peak hours. However, his advice *was ignored*, and they *ended up* having to wait for an hour to find a place to sit.

While *discussing* the project’s timeline with the team, she *noticed* that some members *hadn’t* updated their progress reports for weeks. She suggested they *start* reviewing them immediately to avoid further delays.
options: discussing / noticed / hadn’t been updating / starting
discussing / had noticed / hadn’t updated / starting
discussing / had noticed / hadn’t updating / start
